user_question: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts. Active commitments: analytical_spatial_unit=Centre County census tracts

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Aggregate hospital beds by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Spatially assign hospital points to Centre County census tracts and sum the hospital bed attribute within each tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Use the hospital point layer and census tract polygon layer to compute the total hospital beds per tract. Runtime QC must ground the numeric hospital-bed field from the observed hospital schema and determine the output field name; do not infer or rename fields in advance.

workflow_steps.title: Map total hospital beds by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Generate the final choropleth map from the tract-level hospital-bed totals.
workflow_steps.instructions: Create an interactive HTML choropleth using the aggregated tract layer. Runtime QC must ground the generated total-hospital-beds field from the upstream output; do not guess the mapped field name in advance.

requirements.scope: aggregate_hospital_beds_to_tracts input_1 must contain the numeric hospital-bed field corresponding to total hospital beds
Both point and polygon inputs to the spatial aggregation must have valid non-empty geometries
The hospital points and census tract polygons must use compatible CRSs for spatial aggregation
The polygon aggregation zones must cover Centre County
The aggregated tract output must contain a field representing total hospital beds for thematic mapping
The thematic mapping input must be a supported GeoPackage vector layer

commitments.rationale: The requested choropleth does not specify an analytical unit, while both census tracts and county subdivisions are available. Census tracts provide a standard subcounty reporting unit and directly support a tract-level choropleth.
commitments.evidence_source: user_goal and known input artifacts input_2 and input_3
